title: Beyond the Opening: Tracing the First Token's Persistent Influence on Reasoning Length
abstract: arXiv:2610.34350v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding how individual token choices affect reasoning length is important for characterizing reasoning models. Building on prior findings that changing the first reasoning token (hereafter, the first token) can substantially alter reasoning length, we focus on this initial choice to investigate how its influence operates during subsequent generation. One possibility is that the first token changes the early text that follows, which in turn affects reasoning length. However, replacing only the first token of an existing reasoning prefix and resuming generation substantially changes the remaining reasoning length, even though all other prefix tokens are unchanged. To trace this persistent influence, we compare next-token distributions while varying only the first token and find that sensitivity is concentrated at a small set of generation positions. Blocking attention from these positions to the first token reduces the length gap bet

translated_title: 超越开头：追踪首个Token对推理长度的持续影响
translated_abstract: 理解单个Token的选择如何影响推理长度，对于刻画推理模型的特性至关重要。基于先前关于“改变第一个推理Token（以下简称首Token）能够显著改变推理长度”的发现，我们聚焦于这一初始选择，研究其影响如何在后续生成过程中发挥作用。一种可能性是首Token改变了其后紧随的早期文本，进而影响推理长度。然而，实验表明，仅替换现有推理前缀的首Token并继续生成，就会大幅改变剩余的推理长度，即使前缀中的所有其他Token均保持不变。为了追踪这种持续影响，我们在仅改变首Token的条件下比较下一Token的分布，发现这种敏感性集中在少数生成位置上。阻断这些位置对首Token的注意力可以缩小长度差距……
tldr: 该研究揭示了推理模型中首Token对推理长度具有持续性影响——仅替换首Token即可显著改变后续推理长度，且这种影响集中在少数关键生成位置上，阻断这些位置对首Token的注意力可缩小长度差距。
en_tdlr: This paper traces how the first reasoning token persistently shapes reasoning length, showing that replacing only the first token substantially alters subsequent reasoning length, and that this influence is concentrated at a small set of generation positions where blocking attention to the first token reduces the length gap.
